item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei ordering investigations, prosecutions, dismissals, or other sanctions against police, intelligence, prison, militia, or vigilante perpetrators. I also did not find evidence of a public anti-abuse directive that was actually enforced. The clemency records are not substitutes for accountability.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/","summary":"Amnesty said Iranian authorities were waging a large-scale 2024 campaign to enforce veiling laws through surveillance, mass police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, prison terms, and “morality” classes, with multiple state agencies involved. This is direct evidence of tolerated abuse by police and security institutions.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"Iran: Two years after ‘Woman Life Freedom’ uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/","summary":"Amnesty said there had been no effective, impartial, or independent criminal investigations into security-force killings, torture, sexual violence, or enforced disappearances, and that authorities instead used harassment and arbitrary detention against victims’ families. This is strong evidence of tolerance for abuse and refusal to impose accountability.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"Iran: Security Forces Rape, Torture, Detainees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees","summary":"HRW documented rape, torture, and sexual assault of detainees by security forces and noted that authorities had not investigated or held anyone accountable.
